context_title: best open weight llm model today

entries.query: best open weight llm model today
entries.answer:
The best open-weight LLM **today** depends on what you mean by “best,” but the strongest all-around answer from current public rankings is **GLM-5.2**, which appears at the top of a live open-source leaderboard with a Quality Index of 51.1.[1]

## Best overall
If you want a single pick for broad capability, **GLM-5.2** is the most defensible “best open-weight model today” from the ranking I found, and it is also described as the strongest coding-oriented model on that page.[1]

## Strong alternatives
For long-context, agentic, or coding-heavy work, **Kimi K2.6** is presented by recent coverage as one of the strongest open-weight options, especially for long-horizon coding and autonomous workflows.[2][3]

If you care more about general benchmark prestige and large-scale capability, **Llama 4 Maverick**, **DeepSeek V4**, and **Qwen3 235B** are also repeatedly mentioned among the top open-weight models in recent 2026 roundups.[4][5][6][7]

## Practical choice
For most users, the real answer is not just “which model is best,” but “which model fits my hardware and task.” A top-tier model like GLM-5.2 or Kimi K2.6 may be excellent on paper, while a smaller model can be better if you need something you can actually run locally.[5][8]

## Recommendation
For a simple one-line recommendation: **GLM-5.2 for best overall quality, Kimi K2.6 for coding/agentic work, and Qwen3 or Llama 4 if you want a widely discussed alternative ecosystem**.[7][4][2][5]
